long_biography.plain_text:
Global Switch became a second wealth engine for British investor David Reuben and his brother Simon. The pair acquired the data-centre operator, then sold controlling stakes through two transactions. Their businesses are shared equally, making Reuben Brothers a joint platform rather than a collection of separately attributed assets.

That ownership structure also governs their property activity. Reuben Brothers holds retail, leisure and office assets across several countries, while using both direct acquisitions and property-backed lending. Its loans have financed major hotel, residential and retail developments, sometimes giving the group control when borrowers default. This method lets the brothers move between creditor, owner and developer roles within the same market.
long_biography.html:
Global Switch became a second wealth engine for British investor David Reuben and his brother Simon. The pair acquired the data-centre operator, then sold controlling stakes through two transactions. Their businesses are shared equally, making Reuben Brothers a joint platform rather than a collection of separately attributed assets.

That ownership structure also governs their property activity. Reuben Brothers holds retail, leisure and office assets across several countries, while using both direct acquisitions and property-backed lending. Its loans have financed major hotel, residential and retail developments, sometimes giving the group control when borrowers default. This method lets the brothers move between creditor, owner and developer roles within the same market.

Bloomberg reports that David and Simon share their businesses equally. Corporate, property, technology and other portfolio assets are therefore described as the brothers' or Reuben Brothers' holdings unless a source specifically attributes an asset to David alone.

David's early career was in scrap and international metals trading; Simon's was in carpets and property. The dossier attributes the metals formation to David while treating Trans-World and current Reuben Brothers holdings as joint once the brothers combined their interests.

No reliably verified personal LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, X, YouTube, TikTok or personal website was located. The corporate website is proposed separately, and the existing joint Wikipedia page remains unchanged.

Allegations, legal matters, controversy, politics, private-family trivia, transient valuations, rankings, football-club governance and vessel-specific research are excluded from the dossier's editorial content.
